title: RemoveResult
description: Output of `field remove` — the summary of what was deleted. The modified model is written back to the file (in place, or -o); `--dry-run` writes nothing. Removing a field/group that rules/computations reference is refused unless --cascade, which lists the also-removed references here.

removed.description: the full name-path of the element that was removed

cascaded.description: the rules/computations that referenced the removed field/group and were removed too (only with --cascade; empty otherwise)

written.description: true if the change was written to disk; false under --dry-run
